windows_bcp.notes: BCP 0.7.0 adds offline-first mission stall detection and bounded durable resume intents while preserving low-resource lifecycle, telemetry, Telegram watchdog, and hash-pinned self-update.

android_b_edge.notes: Fresh phone telemetry at 2026-09-19T18:15:29Z proves Samsung SM-A217F is connected and reporting edge_version 2.0.0-rc1 to BCP 0.6.1. Exact installed APK SHA/signature attestation is still required before artifact-level FIELD_VERIFIED.

nexus.notes: Nexus 0.1.9 replaces ephemeral npx execution with a persistent app-owned Wrangler package installed by the pinned portable Node/npm runtime, then invokes wrangler.js directly through node.exe. Windows PowerShell 5.1 native stderr is captured as data so ordinary npm/Wrangler warnings do not become false terminating errors. Exact pinned Node archive, npm install and direct Wrangler execution are exercised on Windows CI. No manual runtime install, secret re-entry, PowerShell, ZIP shuttle, or paid service.
